# function: notifications_managed_notification_child_event

Builds the ARN of an `notifications` `ManagedNotificationChildEvent`:

```
arn:${Partition}:notifications::${Account}:managed-notification-configuration/category/${Category}/sub-category/${Subcategory}/event/${NotificationEventId}/child-event/${NotificationChildEventId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
notifications_managed_notification_child_event(category string, subcategory string, notification_event_id string, notification_child_event_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `category` (String) Value for `${Category}` in the ARN template.
1. `subcategory` (String) Value for `${Subcategory}` in the ARN template.
1. `notification_event_id` (String) Value for `${NotificationEventId}` in the ARN template.
1. `notification_child_event_id` (String) Value for `${NotificationChildEventId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
